answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable until the beacon round is finalized. A participant must commit before the pulse and reveal a response bound to its value, so a swarm cannot precompute valid answers or farm challenges offline. The pulse can serve as a whisper of fresh entropy, not a relic of prior rounds; Sybil limits still require separate admission or resource costs, perhaps measured in shale.
